suspects.description: Pointer-array store through a raw address constant (lost symbolic global; §11/§15) — use the symbolic global indexed by element

Raw hex address 0x54b7af assigned to bare local `uVar21`. The decompiler dropped a symbolic reference — either a data-symbol pointer (recover the symbol from the .asm and replace `uVar21` with symbolic global/array indexing, §11) or a dead code-address store from return-address tracking (delete it, §14). Magic addresses do not survive the relink.
